name: studio
description: The agents that build community apps. Holds no app of its own: each app it builds is a new package, opened as a pull request on credibledata/community-apps.

app-builder.description: Turns a topic, and any articles on it, into a public data app: finds openly licensed data, models it in Malloy, builds the app, and opens a pull request for a person to review. Merging publishes the app and lists it on community.credibledata.com.
